study: spec 030: the carried prior against 2-hour ctl and a joint solve (not a gate)
registered: 2026-11-20, before seeds 365 and 366 exist (generated only in their CI runs)

systems.a: carry2 on 1-hour windows overlapping 15 min: ctl-prior (also ctl, ctl-carry)
systems.b: carry2 on 2-hour windows overlapping 30 min (tag <stem>-2h), stitched mid-overlap: ctl and ctl-prior
systems.c: jointheld: ctl on the union of each turn-free 1-hour window and the one before it, read on the window's rows; history-best over the union as the span reference

windows: held = no ownship turn overlaps the 1-hour window; excluded: each chain's first window, windows with no hand-over in (a), windows any of (a), (b), (c) leaves unanswered

estimands.D3: (b) ctl-prior ÷ (a) ctl-prior (added on tuning, before validation)
estimands.statistic: geometric mean over held windows of per-window median range error; 95% interval from 2,000 bootstrap resamples over engagements (seed 30)

reading: per estimand: 'ctl-prior better' if the lower limit is above 1 (for D3: 1-hour ctl-prior better than 2-hour), 'ctl-prior worse' if the upper limit is below 1, else 'not separated, at this size'

soundness_on_validation.S1: every engagement present for (a), (b) and (c); at least 95% of (a)'s windows ran
soundness_on_validation.S2: per-engagement geometric mean of 1-hour ctl ÷ the true-history fit in [0.8, 4]
soundness_on_validation.S3: coverage of the carried 95% region on hand-overs into held windows in [0.80, 0.99]
soundness_on_validation.on_failure: the study stops before the test
